_comment: Long-episode variant of generator.example_even.json: same style balancing, lengths spread evenly over 5..50 instead of 4..8. The point is the history the agent has to carry -- at length 50 a back reference can point 45 instructions back, where the 4-8 set never asked for more than 7. The even spread over six lengths also gives an SR-against-episode-length curve rather than a single number. 115 episodes generated to land near 100 after the builder drops what it cannot place.
